summary: Acknowledged pause creation becomes retryable after its status refresh fails, creating a duplicate independent hold. Normal exact-ID release, rejected-write retry, focus, responsive layouts and live claim re-enablement were independently exercised.

findings.problem: A successful pause mutation followed by failed list refresh retains the original populated creation form and mutation error. Retry refresh reveals the committed hold but leaves Pause workflow enabled; clicking it creates another independent UUID with identical values.
findings.consequence: An operator recovering from a temporary status-read failure can unintentionally add duplicate holds and must discover and release each separately before execution resumes.
findings.suggestedChange: Record acknowledged creation independently of refresh. Clear or close the completed add form after mutation success, preserve that outcome, and offer Retry refresh without resubmitting creation.

gaps: Optional large-list pagination beyond 20 holds and multiple-operator races were not exercised; representative normal and interrupted mutations were covered.
The shared existing finding 3a0f58d-poll-inflight-projection is attributed to inspected SDLC reproduction evidence; its polling-process UI was not independently rendered.
